title: SentinelAI Agent Guardrails
summary: Give an AI agent a wallet that can only pay what its owner’s on-chain policy allows, with a manual kill switch.
what: SentinelAI is an Anchor 0.30.1 guardrail program. The owner writes a spending policy on chain; the agent signs payments, and the program blocks any payment that breaks the policy or happens while the agent is frozen.
app_note: The page at /dapps/sentinel-ai/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/SentinelAI; only declare_id changed.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/sentinel-ai/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call initialize_agent_profile for an agent key, then set_policy.
try_steps.see: A profile PDA with reputation 50 and your policy PDA.
try_steps.ran: Allowed and blocked payments, freeze and unfreeze (see steps).

diagram: owner --initialize_agent_profile--> profile; owner --set_policy--> policy; agent --submit_transaction--> policy checks --> SOL to receiver (+rep); owner --freeze/unfreeze--> profile.frozen
innovation: Spending limits for an autonomous agent are enforced by the chain, so a compromised agent key still cannot pay outside the policy.
exercises: Why does the circuit breaker never trip, and how would you redesign it so failures are recorded?
How would you support several allowed receivers?
